facts.value: Build a Transfer Map is only available for transfer institutions within the United States and for military Joint Service Transcripts.
ASU only accepts credit from regionally accredited institutions.
Accreditation questions can be referred to your transfer institution or to ASU Admissions Services.
Students from institutions with highly unique or experimental methods of instruction are encouraged to work with an Academic Advisor or transfer specialist.
It is possible that ASU has not yet reviewed your course, or that the content of the course was determined to be insufficient or incompatible with the ASU requirement.
Additional helpful Transfer Guide tools include Course Search and Submit Course for Evaluation.
ASU does allow some courses to fulfill more than one requirement.
A single course may be used to satisfy only one core area according to ASU General Studies policy.
